copy.headline: Dallas Mavericks visit Phoenix Suns Friday in NBA Cup group stage
copy.caption:

story.title: Dallas Mavericks visit Phoenix Suns Friday in NBA Cup group stage
story.summary: The Mavericks have already clinched a spot in the knockout rounds. Dallas Mavericks (11-7, eighth in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (9-8, 10th in the Western Conference), Phoenix; Friday, 8 p.m. CST BOTTOM LINE: The Dallas Mavericks travel to play the Dallas Mavericks in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Suns are 7-8 against Western Conference opponents. Phoenix has a 1-1 record in games decided by less than 4 points. The Mavericks have gone 7-5 against Western Conference opponents. Dallas is 5-4 against opponents with a winning record. The Suns are shooting 47.1% from the field this season, 0.9 percentage points higher than the 46.2% the Mavericks allow to opponents.
